added_failure_basis: the reviewed run's manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite arm (its promotion measures no suite pair), so no gate log carries a failing id to attribute.

durability.reason: a root-cause record that changes no product code; the regression test belongs to the fix node

findings.text: the frame == 146 ternary selects between f"frame-146-trip-{trip}.npz" and f"frame-{frame}-trip-{trip}.npz", which are the same string for frame 146, so the special case is dead and hides that the two branches are identical.

the loop closure adds (phase[1] - phase[0]), the first step, instead of the step from the last sample back to the first, so a gradient field whose unwrap crosses the branch cut near the sampled start can report a winding index off by one.

report() emits out-of-grid polished points with NaN determinant and NaN winding index into trip-trajectory/core-stationary.json, which is not strict JSON and makes the receipt's 'falls outside the flux grid' reading a property a consumer must infer rather than a recorded flag.

justifications.durability: core_stationary_probe.py adds no assertion and no test file exists under the node's write scope, so nothing reddens if the winding index at line 66 or the Hessian classification regresses.
justifications.evidence: The probe's result is on disk at trip-trajectory/core-stationary.json with the Hessian determinant -34.71 and winding index 0 for the frame 146 trip-1 artefact, so the reading is recorded rather than claimed, but the gate at trip-trajectory/gate.log:last is the trajectory driver's EXIT=0 and asserts nothing about this commit.
justifications.fit: core_stationary_probe.py:127 inlines a frame==146 ternary whose two branches build the same path, against the surrounding scripts' plain composition, though the module docstring and naming follow scripts/prototypes/diiid_vertical_loss/render_trip_panels.py conventions.

justifications.reuse: core_stationary_probe.py:84 and :97 call the owners nova/equilibrium/flux_surface_connectivity.py:916 polish_stationary_points and nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:325 fit_tensor_spline, but :28 _seeds and :40 _hessian re-derive a grid seed scan and a finite-difference Hessian that nova/equilibrium/topology.py:1598 stationary_read and the returned hessian_type already carry, so two of four local helpers fork an owned capability.
